title: Arriving in Beijing
description: Airport pick-ups, luggage and umbrellas, then and now, again and again, and finding your way around the city.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē nǐ.
sentences.english: I'll pick you up at the airport.

sentences.pinyin: Mǐgé! Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn!
sentences.english: 米格! Long time no see!

sentences.hanzi: 好久不见！你最近怎么样？
sentences.pinyin: Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn! Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
sentences.english: Long time no see! How have you been?

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
sentences.english: How have you been lately?

sentences.hanzi: 很好！我来帮你拿行李箱。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn hǎo! Wǒ lái bāng nǐ ná xínglixiāng.
sentences.english: Great! Let me take your suitcase.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de xínglixiāng zhēn dà!
sentences.english: Your suitcase is huge!

sentences.hanzi: 谢谢！飞机十一点才到，你等了很久吧？
sentences.pinyin: Xièxie! Fēijī shíyī diǎn cái dào, nǐ děng le hěn jiǔ ba?
sentences.english: Thanks! The plane didn't land until eleven. You must have waited ages?

sentences.pinyin: Fēijī shíyī diǎn cái dào.
sentences.english: The plane didn't land until eleven.

sentences.hanzi: 没事儿！门外有一辆出租车，我们走吧。
sentences.pinyin: Méishìr! Mén wài yǒu yí liàng chūzūchē, wǒmen zǒu ba.
sentences.english: No problem! There's a taxi outside. Let's go.

sentences.pinyin: Mén wài yǒu yí liàng chūzūchē.
sentences.english: There's a taxi outside.

sentences.hanzi: 你看，我们经过天安门了！
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, wǒmen jīngguò Tiān'ānmén le!
sentences.english: Look, we're passing Tiananmen!

sentences.pinyin: Běijīng bǐ yǐqián gèng piàoliang le!
sentences.english: Beijing is even more beautiful than before!

sentences.hanzi: 北京是一个很大的城市。
sentences.pinyin: Běijīng shì yí ge hěn dà de chéngshì.
sentences.english: Beijing is a huge city.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián méi lái guo Běijīng.
sentences.english: I'd never been to Beijing before.

sentences.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒmen jīngcháng lái ba!
sentences.english: Let's come often from now on!

sentences.pinyin: Lǎolao zǒngshì ràng wǒ duō chī.
sentences.english: Grandma always makes me eat more.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yuè xué yuè xǐhuan Zhōngwén.
sentences.english: The more I learn, the more I like Chinese.

sentences.pinyin: Yòu xià yǔ le!
sentences.english: It's raining again!

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
sentences.english: Did you bring an umbrella?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi dài sǎn.
sentences.english: I didn't bring an umbrella.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang zhēn piàoliang.
sentences.english: This place is beautiful.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù shénme dìfang?
sentences.english: Where would you like to go?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shǒujī shàng yǒu dìtú.
sentences.english: I've got a map on my phone.

sentences.hanzi: 饭馆就在前面，我们走过去吧。
sentences.pinyin: Fànguǎn jiù zài qiánmiàn, wǒmen zǒu guòqù ba.
sentences.english: The restaurant is just ahead. Let's walk over.

sentences.pinyin: Zài zǒu yìbǎi mǐ jiù dào le.
sentences.english: Another hundred metres and we're there.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān líkāi Běijīng.
sentences.english: We leave Beijing tomorrow.

sentences.hanzi: 我在地铁上遇到了我的老师。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài dìtiě shàng yùdào le wǒ de lǎoshī.
sentences.english: I ran into my teacher on the subway.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi shì wǒ de lǎoye.
sentences.english: This is my grandpa.

sentences.pinyin: Nín hǎo, jǐ wèi?
sentences.english: Hello, how many of you?

sentences.pinyin: Liǎng wèi.
sentences.english: Two, please.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hěn máng.
sentences.english: I've been busy lately.

exchanges.context: Her sister greets you at the airport after a year.
A waiter greets you and your girlfriend at a restaurant.
It's pouring, and you left your umbrella at home.
A friend asks how you've been. Work has been hectic.
You both want dinner, and the restaurant is close.

grammar.title: 才: later than expected
grammar.body: 才 before the verb shows something happened later than expected: 十一点才到 (didn't land until eleven). 就 is the opposite: sooner than expected.

grammar.title: 越…越…: the more, the more
grammar.body: 越 + A + 越 + B: the more A, the more B. 我越学越喜欢中文.

grammar.title: 又 or 再: again
grammar.body: 又 is for something that has happened again: 又下雨了! 再 is for doing it again in the future: 再说一次.

grammar.title: 位: polite people
grammar.body: 位 is a polite measure word for people: 这位是我的姥爷. Waiters ask 几位? (how many of you?).

grammar.title: 以前 and 以后
grammar.body: 以前: before, in the past. 以后: after, from now on. Both can go at the start: 以后我们经常来吧!

dialogue.title: Listening challenge: Back in Beijing
dialogue.setting: Late at night at Beijing airport. Her sister has come to pick 米格 up.

questions.q: Where are they at the start?
How do they get into the city?
What does 米格 think of Beijing now?
